activity_measure: adult seasonal aggregation
reported_pattern: Adults tend to aggregate in winter and early spring in the sampled northern Taiwan rocky shore population.
geographic_scope: 台灣北部基隆附近岩岸
method: monthly shore sampling
limitations: Single northern Taiwan rocky shore and historical sample; not East Taiwan catch rate or a guaranteed annual fishing window. Candidate c001 is a common-name alias gate; require individual morphological identification before any species-level inference.

activity_measure: general diel activity description
reported_pattern: Species database describes the species as diurnal and adults as associated with exposed rocky surf zones.
geographic_scope: Taiwan species database summary
method: taxonomic/ecological species profile
limitations: No East Taiwan hourly activity measurements, seasonal stratification or quantified activity rate. Does not establish best fishing time. Candidate c001 remains subject to individual identification.

activity_measure: feeding activity under controlled conditions
reported_pattern: Reported feeding approximately 09:00–17:00 with a more pronounced peak around 13:00–15:00 in a controlled algae-feeding study.
geographic_scope: Japan, southern Kii Peninsula, Wakayama
method: captive/controlled algae-feeding study
limitations: Captive/controlled algae feeding is not wild activity, bite rate or response to fishing bait. Do not recommend 09:00–17:00 as an East Taiwan fishing window.

activity_measure: seasonal coastal fishery distribution
reported_pattern: Gillnet catch and habitat modelling showed higher concentration from December to April within 3 nautical miles of western Taiwan coast.
geographic_scope: Western Taiwan coast
sample_size: fishery dataset; exact sample count not stated here
method: gillnet catch locations plus remote-sensing covariates and seasonal MaxEnt model
limitations: Western Taiwan gillnet spatial catch model is not East Taiwan shore-angling diel activity or catch probability; gear, grounds and oceanography differ.

activity_measure: daily telemetry signal count; nighttime signal absence reported
reported_pattern: Daily signal total declined around 16–17°C and no signals were recorded at night during the study; fish remained near the algal bed.
geographic_scope: Nomo-zaki, Nagasaki, Japan; algal bed
study_period: 2004-11 onward; tracked for more than four months
sample_size: study reports telemetry tracking; exact K. bigibbus count not separately specified in this register
method: acoustic/biotelemetry tracking
limitations: Telemetry detections are an activity proxy, not feeding, bite or catch rate. Species-specific to K. bigibbus; do not transfer to K. cinerascens or all white-hair aliases.

activity_measure: general diel activity description
reported_pattern: Species database describes the species as diurnal and associated with mid-upper water over exposed rocky reefs and surf zones.
geographic_scope: Taiwan species database summary; broad rocky-shore distribution
method: taxonomic/ecological species profile
limitations: Broad species profile is not an East Taiwan hourly field study; depth and habitat descriptions are not fishing-depth or bite-time recommendations.

activity_measure: general diel activity description
reported_pattern: Species database describes the species as diurnal and associated with mid-upper water over exposed reefs, algal beds and lagoons.
geographic_scope: Taiwan species database summary; broad rocky-shore distribution
method: taxonomic/ecological species profile
limitations: Broad species profile is not an East Taiwan hourly field study; no quantified activity rate or fishing catch response. Applies only to confirmed K. cinerascens.

activity_measure: juvenile social/territorial behaviour in tide pools at low tide
reported_pattern: Japanese rocky-shore observations describe juveniles confined in tide pools at low tide; after 10–20 minutes, pecking and dominance behaviour gradually appeared. This is a low-tide confinement context, not evidence of a preferred fishing tide.
geographic_scope: 岩岸潮池，日本京都大學瀨戶臨海實驗所附近
method: diving/field observation of schooling and tide-pool behaviour
limitations: Study concerns juvenile social behaviour in Japanese tide pools during low-tide isolation. It does not establish adult feeding response, ebb/flood preference, tidal-current response, or East Taiwan catch rate. Candidate c001 is a vernacular black-hair alias gate; require individual morphological identification before species-level inference.

activity_measure: larval occurrence and current-speed contrast between western Taiwan coastal and estuarine nursery areas
reported_pattern: Larvae were mostly recorded from late winter to early spring. Mean current speed was 39.1 cm/s at coastal sites and 29.6 cm/s in the estuary; sampling was conducted on spring tides. The study did not compare spring versus neap tides or adult feeding/catch response.
geographic_scope: 台灣西部萬公里岸與大肚溪口
sample_size: larval survey; exact number not specified in registry
method: coastal and estuarine larval sampling with environmental comparison
limitations: This is western Taiwan larval nursery evidence, not East Taiwan adult fish activity or angling catch. Spring-tide-only sampling cannot prove spring tides are preferred over neap tides. Current-speed contrast between habitats is not a species current-velocity preference threshold.

activity_measure: verified specimen occurrence
reported_pattern: 一筆中央研究院標本記錄台東成功於2010-03-30採集本種；僅證明當地曾出現，未提供活動或環境反應觀測。
geographic_scope: 台東成功
method: museum specimen; collection method not specified in summary
limitations: 單筆標本只支持當地曾出現，不代表族群密度、季節性、潮汐/海象反應、活動時段或中魚率；不得作為活動分數。

activity_measure: verified adult specimen occurrence
reported_pattern: 標本ASIZP0911844記錄台東基翬於2005-10-06採集成魚1尾，採集方法記載釣獲；只證明該地曾出現。
geographic_scope: 台東基翬
method: museum specimen; capture method recorded as angling
limitations: 單筆標本只支持台東基翬曾出現，不代表族群密度、季節性、潮汐/海象反應、活動時段或中魚率；不得作為活動分數。

activity_measure: verified juvenile specimen occurrence
reported_pattern: 標本FRIP21009記錄台東成功於2005-04-02採集條紋豆娘魚，採集方法一支釣，體長80mm TL；只證明該地曾出現。
geographic_scope: 台東成功
method: museum specimen; one-line hook-and-line capture
limitations: 單筆幼魚標本只支持台東成功曾出現，不代表成魚活動、族群密度、季節性、潮汐/海象反應或中魚率；不得作為活動分數。

activity_measure: verified East Taiwan angling catch occurrence
reported_pattern: 水產試驗所黑潮漁業數位典藏記錄FRIP22025於2007-06-28在花蓮東堤釣魚比賽中以竿釣釣獲，體長300mm、體重485g；僅證明單次釣獲。
geographic_scope: 花蓮東堤
method: rod angling during fishing competition
limitations: 單次競賽釣獲不代表常態釣獲率、季節偏好、潮汐/海象反應或逐時活動；黑毛俗名候選仍須個體鑑種，不得直接解除物種閘門，也不得作為活動分數。

activity_measure: verified tissue specimen occurrence
reported_pattern: 標本ASIZP0805860記錄南方舵魚尾柄肌肉組織，台東三仙台採集，日期2012-04-30；僅證明物種曾出現，無捕獲方式或活動觀測。
geographic_scope: 台東三仙台
method: museum tissue specimen; capture method not reported
limitations: 組織標本只支持物種曾出現，不代表釣獲率、季節性、潮汐/海象反應或逐時活動；不得作為活動分數。

activity_measure: verified tissue specimen occurrence
reported_pattern: 標本ASIZP0802636記錄天竺舵魚尾柄肌肉組織，台東成功採集，日期2006-01-02；僅證明物種曾出現，無捕獲方式或活動觀測。
geographic_scope: 台東成功
method: museum tissue specimen; capture method not reported
limitations: 組織標本只支持物種曾出現，不代表釣獲率、季節性、潮汐/海象反應或逐時活動；不得作為活動分數。

activity_measure: feeding jumps by egg-caring males
reported_pattern: 北台灣研究觀察到護卵雄魚在水流帶來浮游生物時出現明顯跳躍攝食；浮游生物攝食階段的feeding行為相對頻率最高可達59.2%。
geographic_scope: 北台灣沿岸
study_period: 1984 publication; exact observation dates not specified
method: field observation; behavioural budget and first-order transition matrix
limitations: 僅適用護卵雄魚的特定繁殖情境；不能推論一般豆娘魚的日常活動或東部中魚率；研究沒有測量可用作模型門檻的流速；未測量不代表流速沒有影響。

activity_measure: nocturnal browsing on transplanted seaweed
reported_pattern: 日本福江島兩處場域的紅外線縮時攝影記錄到南方舵魚於日落至日出間出現在移植海藻周圍，魚出現後海藻量下降。
time_basis: sunset to sunrise; two sites; two trials per site
geographic_scope: 日本長崎縣福江島（西日本）
sample_size: fish count not reported; two sites; experiment repeated twice at each site
method: in situ seaweed transplant experiment and infrared time-lapse photography
limitations: 直接野外觀察支持此物種在日本場域夜間取食海藻；未量測台灣東部、釣餌攝食或中魚率，也未提供可換算為逐時活動分數的個體計數。不可直接作為東部夜釣加分或最佳時段規則。僅適用已鑑定的 Kyphosus bigibbus。

activity_measure: seasonal horizontal movement range and receiver detections
reported_pattern: 15尾標放個體的接收器偵測顯示個體移動範圍差異大；1至5月各魚每月接收器偵測數低於其他月份，研究推論移動範圍有季節變化。
time_basis: monthly detections; tracking longer than one year
geographic_scope: 日本九州西北部長崎縣壹岐島
study_period: released October–November 2017; tracked for more than one year; published 2024
sample_size: 15 tagged fish; 9 tracked >180 days; 1 tracked 366 days
method: ultrasonic biotelemetry with 10 seabed receivers over approximately 17 km coastline
limitations: 接收器偵測數反映空間移動與接收器覆蓋，不是魚群豐度、覓食率、咬餌率或中魚率；日本壹岐島結果不可直接轉成台灣東部季節分數。僅適用已鑑定的 Kyphosus bigibbus。

activity_measure: diel seaweed consumption under aquarium conditions
reported_pattern: 三缸飼育試驗（每缸10尾）中，南方舵魚對褐藻的攝食活動於傍晚達峰；夜間含暮光攝食量占每日總量45.6%。
geographic_scope: 日本水產研究・教育機構長崎庁舎之飼育試驗（日本）
sample_size: 30 fish across three tanks; 10 per tank
method: aquarium feeding trial; Padina arborescens offered every four hours
limitations: 水族箱試驗的夜間褐藻攝食比例不是野外魚群活動、釣餌攝食或中魚率；不可將45.6%轉成夜間魚情分數。僅適用已鑑定的 Kyphosus bigibbus。

activity_measure: temperature-linked daily feeding rate and diel feeding rhythm
reported_pattern: 飼育試驗顯示水溫20–30°C時對兩種褐藻有攝食，12°C時幾乎不攝食；白天與夜間皆有攝食，日出後及日落前攝食活動較強。
geographic_scope: 日本水產大學校飼育試驗（日本）
method: tank-rearing feeding-rate experiment using Eisenia bicyclis and Sargassum patens
limitations: 飼育條件與特定褐藻試驗不能當作野外活動或釣餌攝食門檻；12°C及20–30°C結果不得直接套用台灣東部海域或轉成分數。僅適用已鑑定的 Kyphosus bigibbus。

activity_measure: daily algal-feeding time and peak under controlled conditions
reported_pattern: 日本和歌山控制試驗記錄臭肚對褐藻攝食約09:00–17:00，13:00–15:00較旺盛。
time_basis: local study time; daily feeding interval
geographic_scope: 日本和歌山縣紀伊半島南岸
method: controlled algae-feeding culture experiment
limitations: 試驗測量特定褐藻攝食，不是野外活動或釣餌咬況；不得轉為台灣東部最佳作釣時段。

activity_measure: seasonal algal feeding peak and associated tank temperature
reported_pattern: 日本和歌山控制試驗中，臭肚對褐藻 Ecklonia 的攝食於9月下旬最旺，試驗水溫26–29°C；該結果只描述飼育條件與特定食物。
geographic_scope: 日本和歌山縣紀伊半島南岸
method: controlled algae-feeding culture experiment
limitations: 飼育褐藻攝食高峰不是台灣東部野外魚群季節分布或釣獲高峰；不得將26–29°C轉為環境適合度門檻。

activity_measure: western Taiwan coastal gillnet catch distribution and seasonal habitat model
reported_pattern: 2015–2018西台灣沿岸刺網漁獲資料與環境遙測MaxEnt模型顯示黑鯛棲地分布有季節差異，12月至翌年4月近岸（小於3海浬）集中較明顯。
geographic_scope: 台灣西部沿岸及台灣海峽
method: coastal gillnet catch-location data plus seasonal MaxEnt habitat model
limitations: 西部刺網作業海域與漁具努力量不等同東部磯釣；季節分布不可直接成為東部活動分數或釣獲機率。

activity_measure: relative environmental variable contribution in seasonal habitat model
reported_pattern: 黑鯛西部沿岸季節MaxEnt棲地模型中，Chl-a與水深合計貢獻約80.1–92.9%，海流速度貢獻低於3%；這是模型變數重要度，不是黑鯛偏好某個海流速度的因果門檻。
geographic_scope: 台灣西部沿岸及台灣海峽
method: seasonal MaxEnt model using gillnet catch, satellite SST, chlorophyll-a, HYCOM current and bathymetry
limitations: 變數貢獻度不可當成生理反應或東部權重；資料為西部刺網漁業且使用Chl-a、水深等現有雷達即時資料未涵蓋變數。不得轉成東部逐時分數。

activity_measure: wild adult stomach-content diet and seasonal food occurrence
reported_pattern: 北台灣基隆岩岸月採樣中，193尾成魚胃含物顯示藻類、橈足類與蝦類糠蝦幼體為重要食物；藻類較常見於2–7月、糠蝦幼體8–9月、橈足類11–12月。研究描述較早時段刮食藻類、較晚時段轉食浮游生物。
time_basis: monthly stomach-content occurrence and qualitative within-day diet shift
geographic_scope: 台灣北部基隆附近岩岸
method: monthly wild fish sampling and stomach-content analysis
limitations: 胃含物比例是已攝食食物組成，不是當下餌料豐度、咬餌率或釣餌偏好；北部舊資料不能直接作東部逐時魚情。c001個體仍須形態鑑種。

activity_measure: seasonal settlement-stage juvenile distribution on Japanese rocky shores
reported_pattern: 日本相模灣及伊豆岩岸採集的Girella punctata稚魚於4–8月出現，5–6月較豐；屬幼魚定居與育幼棲地資料。
geographic_scope: 日本關東至伊豆沿岸（相模灣等地）
sample_size: 813 Girella spp. juveniles across two species; G. punctata subset
method: rocky-shore sampling and genetic species identification
limitations: 研究為日本幼魚定居分布，不是台灣東部成魚活動或釣獲季節；不可外推為成人最佳釣期。c001個體仍須形態鑑種。

activity_measure: juvenile diet and growth response in aquaculture
reported_pattern: 2024年圈養研究評估大型藻類與替代蛋白來源對瓜子鱲幼魚生長表現，未測量野生成魚逐時攝食或釣餌反應。
time_basis: juvenile growth period; no hourly activity metric
geographic_scope: 日本圈養繁殖及育苗研究
method: captive spawning, larviculture and controlled juvenile diet-growth trial
limitations: 幼魚養殖生長結果不能當成野生成魚覓食分數或東部最佳作釣時間；c001個體仍須形態鑑種。

activity_measure: Taiwan-wide fishery season and habitat summary
reported_pattern: 農業部圖鑑記載南方舵魚全年皆產、冬季盛產；該資訊為台灣全域漁業季節背景，未提供逐時釣獲或單位努力量。
geographic_scope: 台灣全域（政府物種漁業圖鑑）
method: government species fishery guide
limitations: 全台漁業季節不等於東部岸釣最佳月份或逐時活動；冬季盛產不得轉成魚情分數。僅適用已鑑定K. bigibbus。

activity_measure: Taiwan-wide year-round fishery and habitat summary
reported_pattern: 農業部圖鑑記載褐臭肚魚全年皆產；冬季味美為食用品質描述，不是冬季魚群活動或釣獲高峰。
geographic_scope: 台灣各沿岸及離島（政府物種漁業圖鑑）
method: government species fishery guide
limitations: 全年皆產及冬季味美不能推論東部季節中魚率或最佳時段；沒有釣獲努力量或逐時活動資料。

activity_measure: Taiwan-wide seasonal fishery summary
reported_pattern: 農業部圖鑑記載黑棘鯛全年皆產、春冬較盛產；此為台灣全域漁業季節概述，未提供東部釣點或逐時資料。
time_basis: year-round; spring and winter higher production
geographic_scope: 台灣全域（政府物種漁業圖鑑）
method: government species fishery guide
limitations: 全台漁業季節摘要不是東部岸釣CPUE或逐時活動；不可轉成東部最佳月份或環境反應權重。

activity_measure: seasonal natural diet composition of adult rabbitfish
reported_pattern: 日本響灘蓋井島64尾成魚胃腸內容物顯示大型褐藻為主食，動物性成分低於濕重2%；春秋食物組成明顯不同。
geographic_scope: 日本響灘蓋井島
method: bottom gillnet and commercial trap net sampling; stomach and intestine analysis
limitations: 日本野生成魚食性不能直接當台灣東部天然餌源量、釣餌反應或逐時魚情；季節食物差異僅作生態背景。

activity_measure: wild adult diet and macroalgae prey availability in Sargassum beds
reported_pattern: 日本馬尾藻床成魚胃腸內容物顯示大型褐藻占胃內容物重量夏季45%、秋季74%；動物性成分分別18%、14%。
geographic_scope: 日本響灘蓋井島兩處混合馬尾藻床
method: daytime spear-gun sampling and gastrointestinal analysis
limitations: 日本藻場食性比例不是台灣東部即時藻量或可利用餌源；不可直接換算覓食分數。

activity_measure: macroalgae density-dependent feeding under tank conditions
reported_pattern: 20尾臭肚在人工藻株密度15及30株/平方公尺時強烈攝食Ecklonia kurome；5株密度時幾乎不啃食。
geographic_scope: 日本和歌山縣研究機構水槽試驗
method: concrete tank experiment with artificial seaweed stocks
limitations: 水槽人工藻株密度不可直接成為台灣東部自然藻場門檻或魚情分數；僅指出餌源密度可能重要。

activity_measure: animal matter and macroalgae food selection in tank
reported_pattern: 日本水槽研究比較冷凍磷蝦、魚類餌料與大型褐藻，指出臭肚在飼育條件下亦會取食動物性餌料，成魚不能簡化成純草食。
geographic_scope: 日本水產大學校水槽試驗
method: indoor tank feeding comparison
limitations: 人工餌料接受度不等於野外天然食物比例或釣餌偏好；不得轉成覓食分數。

activity_measure: monthly diel movement pattern in tank experiments
reported_pattern: DIDSON水槽觀察中，臭肚8月及12月白天活動較多，7月試驗則夜間活動較多；顯示日夜活動型態可能隨月份改變。
time_basis: July nighttime activity higher; August and December daytime activity higher
geographic_scope: 日本小型水槽試驗
method: DIDSON acoustic-camera observation in July, August and December
limitations: 水槽移動活動不是野外覓食或中魚率；月份差異不得直接轉成東部最佳時段，但不支持全年固定日行模型。

activity_measure: feeding on brown macroalgae across four day and night windows
reported_pattern: Two tanks each held 10 fish (40.0–43.5 cm); brown algae were offered 04:00–07:00, 11:00–14:00, 17:00–20:00 and 21:00–24:00. Consumption was similar across the four periods, supporting captive nocturnal browsing ability.
geographic_scope: 日本長崎／五島研究機構水槽
method: controlled tank feeding trial with Ecklonia kurome and Padina arborescens
limitations: 人工水槽與禁食後供餌設計，不等同野外磯釣咬餌；僅確認此物種具夜間攝食能力。；尚無台灣東部野外逐時驗證。

activity_measure: four-hourly diel feeding rhythm on Padina arborescens
reported_pattern: In three tanks with 10 fish each, feeding increased through morning and early afternoon, peaked late afternoon, remained high at 18:00–22:00, and night including twilight contributed 45.6% of daily intake; day/night totals did not differ significantly.
geographic_scope: 日本長崎縣福江島戶外水槽
method: repeated 24-hour aquarium feeding experiments; 4-hour sampling
limitations: 研究作者指出水槽夜間覓食不一定反映自然海域；不可將45.6%或時段峰值當成東部野外權重。；尚無台灣東部野外逐時驗證。

activity_measure: hourly vertical ascent/descent frequency from ultrasonic biotelemetry
reported_pattern: 13尾繁殖期成魚（8雄、5雌）在日本牡蠣養殖場追蹤；雌雄垂直移動皆於傍晚較多，傍晚雄魚升降頻率超過雌魚三倍。研究者認為移動很可能與求偶／產卵活動有關。
time_basis: Day 10:00–15:59; evening 16:00–21:59; night 22:00–03:59; spawning-season tracking centered on sunset
geographic_scope: 日本廣島灣牡蠣養殖場
study_period: 繁殖季追蹤於2019、2020及2022年5–6月；論文2026年發表
method: Field ultrasonic biotelemetry; horizontal position about every 30 minutes and depth tracked for about 20 minutes in hourly windows
limitations: 日本半封閉海灣牡蠣養殖人工結構、限定產卵季及13尾成魚；傍晚垂直移動可能反映繁殖行為，不能代表索餌或咬餌，也不能代表台灣東部岩岸成魚全年活動或最佳釣時。
